correctness.rationale: Collision iff multiplicity intersection >=3. At most q heavy vectors by unique >=3 coordinate; at most one all-<=2 vector for n>=q+2 via I>=2n-2q; none once n>2q. Pure codewords plus a 1/2-vector attain q+1 in q+2..2q, pure vectors attain q later. At n=q+1, two light vectors show strictness. At n=2q and 2q-1, all light vectors and heavy compatibility are fully classified; q^2 counting has no duplicates because distinguished light vector is unique. Computational enumeration of 30,007 finite input profiles checks constructions and rigidity; infinite proof is separate.

value.rationale: Sharp phase boundaries resolve the previously nonexact high-deletion upper-bound regime for every q>=5. It specifies both optimal code size and the complete labeled-optimum enumeration at the two final plateau lengths (one unique at n=2q; exactly q^2 at n=2q-1), an interpretable heavy/light structural transition useful in permutation-channel design rather than a single ad hoc finite parameter. A q+2 construction at n=q+1 makes the earlier phase boundary genuine.
